The Books section has two kinds of material. The first group contains two rendered textbook collections and one governed technical monograph. The second contains four provisional research-development manuscripts that share this navigation sidebar.

## Publication State

The four volume pages and their canonical LaTeX sources are **available** at the reviewed revision. Their notebook companions are **scaffolded**, meaning the file and tutorial title exist; that status does not establish numerical correctness, successful execution, dependency availability, or reproducibility. The proximal-to-distal monograph is an **available computational publication** with an immutable source manifest and exact PDF, chapter, and evidence contracts. It is not a completed or peer-reviewed textbook, an archival or PID-qualified publication, human validation, coaching guidance, or a software capability promise.

Use the Books and Textbooks sidebar to move between these pages. Individual chapter pages are indexed in [Article Index](../resources/articles.html).

## Proximal-to-Distal Study Library

Use the technical monograph as the governed reference. Choose the companion for a more accessible reading path, the summary for a shorter synthesis, and the workbench for exploratory model runs. A model result remains conditional on its declared system, state, inputs, and comparison; none of these routes establishes human validation or a universal swing prescription.

- [Technical Monograph](../articles/proximal_distal_energy_transfer/index.html): the computational publication, exact source authority, equations, claims, falsifiers, and evidence ledgers.
- [How a Golf Swing Carries Energy](../articles/proximal-distal-a-journey-through-the-swing.html): a 30-chapter visual companion with the same interpretation boundaries.
- [Technical Summary](../articles/proximal-distal-energy-transfer.html): a shorter route through the central counterfactual and energy-accounting arguments.
- [Interactive Model Workbench](../articles/proximal-distal-model-workbench.html): guided exploratory experiments whose outputs are not measured golfer data.
